name: Ayfie International AS
summary: Ayfie International AS, headquartered in Oslo, Norway, is a specialized software company focused on delivering advanced search solutions. The firm develops innovative site search and knowledge discovery tools, serving clients throughout Norway, Scandinavia, and the broader European market. Its key products include Locator, an enterprise-grade indexing and search platform engineered to unearth data from various applications and systems, and AppSearch, a user-friendly, plug-and-play service designed to eliminate the necessity for manual coding for developers and application users. Beyond its core software, Ayfie offers a suite of services, such as sophisticated text analytics, comprehensive support and maintenance, dedicated retainer development, and expert professional and consultancy services. The company's underlying platform leverages cutting-edge technologies from the fields of insight engines and content analytics. Formerly operating as ayfie Group AS, the company rebranded to Ayfie International AS in June 2024.
